A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CycleGRPO work, with readable text, equations, ten tables, nine numbered figures, and Appendices A–I. The changed pagination reflects reformatting rather than missing material.

before.justification: v1 reports original CycleGRPO benchmark evaluations, ablations, training dynamics, and qualitative results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The two-stage captioning/localization procedure, model backbones, cycle rewards, and optimization remain unchanged. Appendix A's hierarchical token-grading implementation already appears in v1.

E1.justification: Training data and task coverage are retained, including DenseWorld/GRES training and the DAM-based controlled comparison. Both evaluate DLC-Bench, GAR-Bench-VQA, GCG, GRES, GroundingSuite, and appendix GroundingME, with the same mask and bounding-box scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments, including Tables 1–10 and the GroundingME comparison. SAMTok, standard GRPO, per-task GRPO variants, and the benchmark-specific external baselines are retained.

E3.justification: Both report the same training budget, batch size, rollout settings, model sizes, evaluation splits, and metrics. The 804-sample GroundingME subset and both DLC-Bench judging modes are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The same per-task GRPO, rollout-count, grounding-format, and backbone ablations remain. Appendix training-dynamics analyses, data-scaling experiments, and qualitative cases are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged: neither version adds seeds, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Appendix E retains the same three configuration-specific training runs.

E6.justification: The numerical entries and qualitative findings match across the main text and appendices. For example, CycleGRPO retains DLC-Bench average 67.7, GroundingSuite gIoU 67.6, and GroundingME mIoU 37.3 versus SAMTok's 29.5.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), the reward definitions, and the mathematical formulation of cycle consistency are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims: a single model jointly improves understanding and localization through cycle rewards without textual ground truths or external judges, with transfer across tasks and spatial representations.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, region-VQA attribute-versus-relation tradeoff, training-stability interpretation, and data-efficiency discussion are unchanged. Appendix H retains the same qualifications concerning inherited biases and deployment.

D1.justification: The verl implementation, trainable components, optimizer settings, prompt templates, token-grading details, and code/model access statement are retained. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The same 80 reference entries and related-work arguments are retained. Bibliography styling changes, but cited-work membership and positioning relative to earlier research do not.

P1.justification: The author and affiliation block changes: Jason Li is removed, Zhuochen Wang and Xiangtai Li are added, and affiliations and corresponding-author information are revised. Scientific prose and the sequence of Sections 1–6 and Appendices A–I remain unchanged.

P2.justification: A document-wide redesign introduces a larger page format, institutional logos, a boxed abstract, blue headings, revised typography and caption styling, and extensive resizing and relocation of figures and tables. The existing scientific displays are preserved, including Figure 9's cases redistributed across pages.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially restyles the document and updates its front matter, while retaining the complete scientific argument, results, appendix analyses, and reproducibility information. These primarily cosmetic changes neither resolve a substantive deficiency nor introduce a meaningful loss in overall paper quality.
